description_en: Queries the online status of multiple clients by client ID
description_zh: 根据 Client ID 批量查询客户端在线状态
kebab_example: aliyun onsmqtt batch-query-session-by-client-ids --instance-id post-cn-0pp12gl0000 --client-id-list ClientIdList.1 --api-version 2020-04-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: BatchQuerySessionByClientIds

parameters.help_en: The instance ID of ApsaraMQ for MQTT. Must match the instance ID used by the client. Find it on the Instance Details page in the console (https://mqtt.console.aliyun.com)
parameters.help_zh: 云消息队列 MQTT 版实例的ID，一定要和客户端实际使用的实例ID匹配。您可以在控制台 (https://mqtt.console.aliyun.com)实例详情页面获取该ID
parameters.name: instance_id

OnlineStatusList.description_en: The online status of each queried client

ClientId.description_en: The client ID, as defined in [Terms]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/42420.html）
ClientId.description_zh: 客户端的Client ID。Client ID的详细信息，请参见[名词解释]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/42420.html）

OnlineStatus.description_en:
Whether the client is online. Valid values:

true: The client is online.

false: The client is offline
OnlineStatus.description_zh:
设备是否在线，取值说明如下：

true：在线
false：不在线

RequestId.description_zh: 公共参数，每个请求的ID都是唯一的
